## Items

"Fixed?" is checked against the code and `docs/`. "Fits CIGAR?" is judged against
`cigar-design-philosophy`: a hotkey terminator; one designed action per situation; a prompt
performs the whole action; curated, never configurable rules.

   it may already be solved. #2 (after bathing) is a separate lead.
